trap:the-c-selftest-is-one-console-app-h.text: The C# SelfTest is one console app holding most of the offline checks (325+ cases); a Python wrapper `src/RimMandrake/Utils/selftest_flowworks_stock.py` builds it with Windows `dotnet.exe`. One run covers many bars.

trap:the-inventory-s-proof-field-reads-s.text: The inventory's `proof` field reads `stale` (20), `missing` (7) or `exercised_unrecorded` (1): it records proof-run freshness on 2026-11-05, not whether a test exists.

trap:the-stage-3-offline-checks-of-five-.text: The Stage 3 offline checks of five bars are source laws, not behaviour runs (`selftest_stage3_owed.py`): the code is Verse-bound. They decide "the code that would make the bar true exists and has this shape"; whether it works is the scene's question at Stage 6.

trap:three-bar-vocabularies.text: Three bar vocabularies. The 57 checklist rows are the bars of 0.1.0. The sheet's `[floor:…]` lines (mod_settings, tick_cost, worldgen, multiplayer) and the 22 lines of `floor.json` are floor lines every mod meets, not among the 59. […]

trap:three-inventory-rows-are-impl-absen.text: Three inventory rows are `impl: absent` at the lock: `inv_prison_no_bed`, `inv_toss_flame`, `inv_raider_fetch_fallen`. Their leaves (`drained_hole_is_a_prison`, `toss_flame_from_rim`, `raiders_fetch_their_fallen`) are owed code, not owed tests. (`inv_irrigation`, `unknown` at the lock, left for 0.2.0.)
